headline: Van Gerwen fights back from 2-0 down to beat Wade 10-8
standfirst: Michael van Gerwen came from behind against James Wade, winning five of the last six legs to reach the Grand Slam of Darts quarter-finals.
body: Michael van Gerwen beat James Wade 10-8 in the last 16 of the Grand Slam of Darts on Thursday night, setting up a quarter-final against Tom Sykes. He made five breaks of throw to Wade’s four.
Wade started brightly, winning the first two legs and going 3-1 ahead with a 105 checkout. Van Gerwen won the next two, including a break, to level at 3-3, and Wade edged back in front at 4-3.
Van Gerwen broke with a 120 finish to make it 4-4 and took the next leg in 11 darts, the quickest of the night. Wade won three of the next four, with checkouts of 106 and 130, to lead 7-5.

The Dutchman had the answer. He won four legs in succession, including a 121 finish to level at 7-7 and two further breaks of throw, to go 9-7 clear. Wade held with a 130 checkout to stay in touch at 8-9, but van Gerwen broke again to close out the match.
Van Gerwen plays Sykes on Saturday evening, with the winner in the semi-finals.
